arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc WHERE c.description = 'Grocery Stores, Supermarkets'
arguments.explanation: Counts every transaction at a merchant whose category description is 'Grocery Stores, Supermarkets'.
assumptions: The category is matched exactly on mcc_codes.description = 'Grocery Stores, Supermarkets'.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label, and including those with negative amounts or errors.
